summary: The update ledger moved from `docs/changelog/updates` to `data/changelog/updates` in one rename commit, and every reader points at the new home while each row's `specs[]` still resolves through the docs tree.
reader_impact: An admin reading `/admin/docs/updates` sees the same rows, order and links; the published docs bundle no longer carries the app's ledger, and a bundle gate checks `specs[]` against the tree it serves.
